title: A dead Linux helper fails one command, not the Pi process
hypothesis: launch_browser wrote to the Linux helper's stdin with no error listener; an unstartable bridge raised EPIPE unhandled and killed the whole trial.
measurement: 4 component tests; removing the listeners reproduces the production 'Error: write EPIPE', and removing only the kill fails the orphan case. Archive contract 11/11, 16 benchmark-runner and 11 adapter tests pass. Sandbox rerun: the tool returns isError and the trial is scored.
result: child stdin/stdout/stderr get error listeners that reject pending commands and SIGTERM the child, so a failed stream cannot leave an orphan helper. Shipped as @injaneity/pi-computer-use 0.5.1-rotom.12; only that file and the version differ from .rotom.11, native prebuilt bytes reused.
